releases.name: Anka 1.0.1
releases.body:
**Anka 1.0.1** opens games stored as **.nup** packages.

Built from [`anka`](https://github.com/EddizEge/Anka/tree/anka) at `2d17a71ff0f0cf0c27b3d7207818fade9199b77b`; both programs carry this commit.

## Updating from 1.0.0

Close Anka, unzip **`Anka-1.0.1-win64.zip`** into your Anka folder and replace the files. Your `user` folder (settings, keys, firmware and saves) stays as it is.

New to Anka: follow the quick start in the [1.0.0 notes](https://github.com/EddizEge/Anka/releases/tag/anka-v1.0.0). Unzip into a new, empty folder, start `anka.exe`, and install your own keys and firmware.

## What's in 1.0.1

### .nup packages
- `.nup` ("Unencrypted (Archival) Package") is a container format from upstream Eglantine. It holds one title's base game, update and add-on content in a single file.
- Anka now **reads** .nup files. You can open them with **File › Load File…**, and they appear in the game list with their icon, name and version. `anka-cli.exe` and its launchers open them too, including from the `Games` folder.
- Mods (LayeredFS) and Anka's game-specific settings apply to games opened from a .nup, the same as for other formats. Anka finds the title ID before the game starts.

releases.name: Anka 1.0.0
releases.body:
First release of **Anka**, a Nintendo Switch 2 emulator for Windows, focused on performance.

Built from [`anka`](https://github.com/EddizEge/Anka/tree/anka) at `b7542ece8b5c695e2f01d5e46b74c0806d48ae96`; both programs carry this commit.

## Quick start

1. Unzip **`Anka-1.0.0-win64.zip`** into a **new, empty folder**. Do not unzip it into another emulator's folder: its Qt DLLs would replace that program's.
2. Start **`anka.exe`**. Anka keeps its settings, keys, firmware and saves in the `user` folder next to it (portable mode) and does not touch `%APPDATA%\eden` or other installs.
3. Install your own keys and firmware as with other Eden-based emulators. Anka includes no games, keys or firmware; only use what you legally own.
4. Settings: **Emulation › Configure… › Anka**. The first start picks *Recommended*, the setup we measured (with GPU Mode *Fast*, the default; it also turns Reactive Flushing off).

Coming from PokeDinner-Eglantine 2.0.0: back up its `nand` folder (your saves), then copy its `user` folder next to `anka.exe`.

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) and a GPU with a current Vulkan driver. Qt and the Visual C++ runtime come with Anka.

Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64.AppImage, for 4K, 16K and 64K page kernels alike
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)

Coming from an old nightly? Nightlies are now a separate app, ARMSX2 Nightly, next to stable.

- Android: stable cannot install over an old nightly. Back up your saves and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install the stable APK.
- iOS: your old nightly is the ARMSX2 iOS app and still has your saves. Copy them into ARMSX2 Nightly with the Files app.

releases.name: FF7Recomp 1.1.62
releases.body:
**Fixed: crashes in some scenes with Echo-S voices and ChaOS's Resized Models (#91)**

Reported in issue #91: with Echo-S 7's voices on, the game closed in some scenes, for example on boarding the Highwind from the world map.

Two mods were each changing half of the same scene. ChaOS's **BETA: Resized Models** option replaces the list of character models for 693 scenes, a list made to match the original game's scene scripts. Echo-S's voiced version brings its own scene scripts, and in 39 scenes those use more characters than ChaOS's list loads. In the Highwind's deck, for example, the scripts use 14 models and ChaOS's list has 10. The game then tried to animate a character that was never loaded and crashed on the first frame. (ChaOS's own description of the option warns that it can crash with gameplay mods.)

Now, when a mod's model list doesn't match the models the scene's scripts use, that list is left out for that scene, and the scene keeps the models that came with its own file. In those 39 scenes the characters have their normal size instead of ChaOS's resized one; everywhere else Resized Models works as before. The log (`ff7.log`) names each scene where this happens.

releases.name: v1.1.61
releases.body:
**Fixed: rare crashes at scene changes with sound-effect mods on (#90)**

Reported in issue #90: once in a while the game closed when entering a battle, leaving the menu, or moving between areas, more often with many mods on and little free memory. The crash records all showed the same thing: some other part of the app had a pointer whose lower half had been overwritten with zeros earlier on.

We tracked it down with a special memory-checking build on our test device, which caught it within a minute. The cause was in FFNx's sound-effect code, which is active whenever a mod replaces the game's sound effects (Echo-S, the Tsunamods set and others). It keeps one record per sound channel. Some calls used the wrong channel number, and every battle transition touched a channel that had no record. Each time, the game wrote a few bytes just past the end of that table, usually zeros, into memory that belonged to something else. Most of the time nothing happened; sometimes it hit a pointer, and whatever used that pointer next crashed.

releases.name: v1.1.60
releases.body:
**Fixed: the game could close a while after loading a save state from an earlier session (#91)**

Reported in issue #91 with Echo-S 7 voices on. The game keeps one data file open the whole time it runs: the sound archive it loads its own sound effects from. A save state stores the game's memory, and that memory held the open file's handle as it was in the session where the state was made. After you closed the game and loaded the state in a later session, that handle no longer pointed at anything. The next time a scene needed a sound the game hadn't loaded yet, the game crashed.

Whether you hit this depended on luck. It was more likely with mods that open many files, like Echo-S voices.

Save states now record which files the game has open, and opening them again is part of loading a state. States made with older versions are covered too: the sound archive is opened again when they load.

### Updating
Go to **Settings → Updates** in the launcher (or install this APK over your current version), then press **Play**. It asks to **Update the game** once (a few seconds).

APK SHA-256: `f29167fd9f2e8d88814386aacf28742669a42cc58810be4dca13f5972d3dd3ab`

releases.name: v1.1.59
releases.body:
**New: the launcher says what kind of device runs the game best, and what helps after a crash**

Suggested in issue #90. Rare crashes when a battle or scene is drawn for the first time are most often the phone running low on memory while the graphics driver prepares that scene's shaders. That is a hardware limit more than a bug, so the launcher now says so where you'll see it:

- **After the game crashes** (or Android closes it for memory), the launcher shows a short note once: what most often causes it, what helps, and a button to **Report a problem** if it keeps happening.
- **Report a problem** and **Game files** (first setup) show the recommendation.
- **Settings → Renderer** now recommends **OpenGL ES** on Mali GPUs (most MediaTek and Exynos phones).
- The README has the same line under *Playing*.

The recommendation: **8 GB of RAM or more, with other apps (browser tabs too) closed while you play.** Heavy mod sets need the most memory, above all on Vulkan. On Mali GPUs, OpenGL ES is usually the steadier choice.

![The note the launcher shows once after the game crashed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bhuiyah/ff7-recomp-android/main/docs/release-images/1.1.59-crash-tip.jpg)

releases.name: v1.1.58
releases.body:
**Fixed: the graphics-driver crash protection from 1.1.57 now covers OpenGL ES too**

1.1.57 started keeping the game's finished GPU programs on your device when you play on Vulkan, so the graphics driver doesn't have to compile them again on every launch (that compiler is where the crash in issue #90 happened). Many players use OpenGL ES instead, because Vulkan is slower on their phone, so the same now happens there: once the game has drawn something on OpenGL ES, later launches load the finished program instead of compiling it again.

If your driver ever refuses one of the kept programs (for example after a driver update), the game simply builds it again the normal way. As before, the first time you reach a scene still has to compile it, so this makes the crash less likely rather than impossible.

### Updating
Go to **Settings → Updates** in the launcher (or install this APK over your current version), then press **Play**. It asks to **Update the game** once (a few seconds).

The first release since [0.3.0](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.3.0): a faster game, a picture closer to the console's, and two experimental options that make it faster still.

## New

- **Faster on every level.** The emulated kernel woke every waiting thread whenever anything was signalled (one of the game's locks is released some 50,000 times a second); now only the threads waiting for that object wake. The game's CPU use dropped from about 5.4 cores to 3.3, and the forest at 1080p without MSAA went from about 91 to 95–108 frames a second.
- **Native command lists (experimental)**, in the F11 menu, after a restart. The draws are made from the game's own Direct3D calls, and the console's GPU command stream is run only for what the GPU still has to do. With **Watch memory writes (experimental)** also on, the forest at 1080p without MSAA runs at about 180 frames a second. Tested on eight levels, the films and mission restarts; off by default until it has been played more.

A fix release over [0.2.2](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.2.2), and the one worth updating for: the lighting is right now.

## Fixed

**Walls lit far too brightly, and the odd shading on the soldiers and on the player's hands.** An instruction of the console's shaders has a vector half and a scalar half, and they run together: both read the registers as they were before the instruction and only then write. The translation wrote the vector's result first, so a scalar that read the very register the vector wrote got the new value instead of the old one.

The game's third light per surface is written exactly that way. Its scalar wants the specular exponent times a logarithm; with the write first it took a dot product instead, and two to the tenth of that became the specular. Every lit stone wall in Mayenne came out white with pink and green speckle, and characters were shaded oddly for the same reason. Eighty of the six hundred shader programs a level draws with have such an instruction, so this shows up all over the game, not only on that wall.

## Known issues

releases.name: Call of Duty 3 - PC Port - 0.2.2
releases.body:
You need **Xbox360 Call of Duty 3 (USA, Europe).iso** file for install!

A fix release over [0.2.1](https://github.com/FrankHUN88453/CoD3Recomp/releases/tag/v0.2.1); everything below is on top of what 0.2.1 brought.

## Fixed

**The HUD and the menu still flickered.** 0.2.1 looked at every texture every frame again, but a large one that had been still for a while was only *sampled*: sixty four places out of it. The HUD's fonts, icons and compass are small and change a handful of texels at a time, and the samples missed those changes, so the old picture stayed up for a frame. Everything up to two megabytes is now hashed whole, every frame, and only what is bigger than that falls back to sampling.

**Shadow filtering collapsed.** A texture fetch on the console carries three signed offsets in halves of a texel. The game's shadows are one map fetched four times at the corners of a texel; with the offsets dropped those were four fetches of the same texel, so a surface came out wholly lit or wholly dark instead of softly edged.

releases.body:
## 核心变更

### 1. Flyme 12.6 / Android 16 反孤儿进程根治（`libsubreaper.so`）
- 经魅族 21 Note（Flyme 12.6 / Android 16）控制变量实测，系统会在 `< 100ms` 内静默终止普通应用 UID 下托孤给 `init`（`PPID=1`）的孤儿进程。
- 内置 368 字节纯静态 PIE（`ET_DYN`、64KB 对齐）AArch64 启动器 `lib/arm64-v8a/libsubreaper.so`，通过 `prctl(PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER, 1)` 接管整个 Wine 进程子树并循环 `wait4(-1)` 回收已退出子进程（含 `-EINTR` 重试，兼容暂停/恢复）。
- 通过 `ImageFs.find(Context)` → `ProcessHelper.initNativeLibDir()` → `ProcessHelper.wrapWithSubreaper()` 接入启动链，彻底移除早期写死 `proton-9.0-arm64ec/lib/wine/aarch64-unix/ntdll.so` 的原地二进制补丁与 `wineserver -f -p` 预启动变通方案。
- **实测结果**：使用原版未修改 `ntdll.so` 即可进入容器，`wineserver`、`services.exe`、`winedevice.exe`、`plugplay.exe`、`rpcss.exe`、`explorer.exe` 全程挂载在 `libsubreaper.so` 下存活且零僵尸进程；不再局限于 `proton-9.0-arm64ec`，实测 `proton-9.0-x86_64` 也可正常进入容器。

### 2. 手柄无响应问题修复（虚拟手柄 / XInput）
- `services.exe` 与 `winedevice.exe`（承载 `winebus.sys`、`winehid.sys`、`winexinput.sys`、`libSDL2`、`libfakeinput.so`）在 `wineboot.exe` 退出后不再因成为孤儿被系统击杀，手柄驱动链路保持存活。
- 修正 `WineUtils.changeServicesStatus()` 中正常/精简模式将 `winebus` / `winehid` 设为禁用（`Start=4`）的问题，改为 `Start=3`，并升级配置标记为 `startupSelection_v4` 使旧容器启动时自动修复注册表。

### 3. 注册表与 Wine 开始菜单汉化补齐

## Novità per gli amministratori

- I dati locali (ROM in cache, copie dei salvataggi, stati salvati) sono legati all'account e non più al nome utente: dopo un cambio di nome restano al loro posto. Alla prima apertura vengono spostati automaticamente.

Server [nds-server-emulator-fastapi](https://github.com/federico-castellani/nds-server-emulator-fastapi) aggiornato (commit `7d2701c`). Con un server precedente l'app funziona, ma le nuove funzioni di amministrazione non sono disponibili.

releases.name: NDS Station per Android 2.0.1

Prima versione per Android di NDS Station, con le stesse funzioni del client Windows 2.0.1.

- Emulatore melonDS con tasti virtuali su schermo, touch sullo schermo inferiore, controller fisici, pausa, avanti veloce e stati salvati.

Scarica `NDSStation-2.0.1.apk` sul telefono e aprilo (va consentita l'installazione da origini sconosciute). L'APK è firmato con una chiave di sviluppo: per aggiornarlo in futuro usa sempre gli APK di queste release.

Bug reports sent from msr2ds itself, Discord Rich Presence, and fixes for Arachnus, the Teleport Station and 30 FPS.

releases.body:
Windows, Linux (x86_64 and ARM64), macOS (Apple Silicon) and Android (arm64).

## What changed since 2.1.0

Stereoscopic 3D, nothing missing in wide views anymore, and a log for every play session.

- **Stereoscopic 3D** (#17). Side by side, for 3D TVs, Acer SpatialLabs displays and VR headsets. The game draws both eyes itself, as on a 3DS. On the Display tab: **Stereoscopic 3D** (side by side at half width or at full width), **3D depth** (the 3DS's 3D slider, 10-100%) and **Swap eyes**. It needs the Vulkan renderer.
- **Nothing missing in wide views.** In 16:9 and ultrawide, some breakable blocks and pieces of rock were not drawn. The game draws at most 300 level pieces at a time, and a wider view holds more than that. Now every piece in view is drawn.
- **The game's message boxes keep their shape.** "Save your progress?", "Use the Teleport Station?" and the other boxes the game shows over play no longer stretch in 16:9 and ultrawide.

releases.name: msr2ds 2.1.0
releases.body:
Windows, Linux (x86_64 and ARM64), macOS (Apple Silicon) and Android (arm64).

## What changed since 2.0.9

A fix for the Android phones that crashed at the title screen in 2.0.9, and a pause screen redone for controllers and wide screens.

- **Android: no more crash at the title screen on Adreno 830 phones** (#58, #37). On Snapdragon 8 Elite devices (the Odin 3 and phones with the same chip), 2.0.9 crashed at the first 3D scene: the graphics driver's shader compiler crashed building 2.0.9's new per-material lighting. On Adreno GPUs, lighting now works as it did in 2.0.8, and the lighting code is back in the shape their compiler handled. Other GPUs keep 2.0.9's faster lighting. If 2.0.9 left the app in its safe graphics mode after a crash, this update clears it.
- **The pause screen fills the window**, now on by default (HUD tab: **Fit the pause screen to the window**). Its bars and background reach the window's edges, its buttons and text keep their shape, and the map fills the width, so you see more of the area.

releases.name: msr2ds 2.0.9
releases.body:
Windows, Linux (x86_64 and ARM64), macOS (Apple Silicon) and Android (arm64).

## What changed since 2.0.8

Mostly Android fixes, and faster lighting everywhere.

- **Android: "Not built yet" with the native code in place** (#58, #63). On some devices (an Odin 3 in #58), Android gives a `recomp-android` folder copied in from a PC an owner the app can't read. The app now makes the `recomp-android` folder itself, so a copy from the PC goes into a folder it owns. If a folder you copied in earlier can't be read, the launcher says so and what to do: delete that folder from the PC, then copy the two files from the PC's `recomp-android` folder (`libmsr_aot.so` and `module.json`) into the empty one the app makes in its place. A copy dropped inside the app's folder (`recomp-android/recomp-android`) is moved up. `launcher.log` says what the launcher found.

# IZPSX emulator 0.5.3

IZPSX runs PlayStation games on Nintendo Switch 2 through [IZ2S](https://github.com/byizmysh/IZ2S-Platform).

## Install

### Through IZ2S App library

1. Download [`izpsx-emulator-0.5.3.iza`](https://github.com/byizmysh/IZPSX-emulator/releases/download/v0.5.3/izpsx-emulator-0.5.3.iza).
2. In IZ2S, open **App library**, import the `.iza` file, and install it to the Switch 2 SD card. IZ2S installs the emulator in `SD:/iz2s/modules/izpsx/`. The installer includes the launcher, engine, shaders, font, and interface assets.

### Directly to the SD card

1. Download [`izpsx-emulator-0.5.3.zip`](https://github.com/byizmysh/IZPSX-emulator/releases/download/v0.5.3/izpsx-emulator-0.5.3.zip).
2. Extract the ZIP to the root of the Switch 2 SD card so `iz2s/` sits at the top level. The archive includes the emulator files and empty `bios/`, `games/`, and `saves/` folders under `SD:/iz2s/modules/izpsx/`.

Preserve your BIOS, games, memory cards, and settings when updating.

## BIOS and games

| File | SD card path |
| --- | --- |
| Your own PlayStation BIOS, exactly **512 KiB (524,288 bytes)** | `SD:/iz2s/modules/izpsx/bios/bios.bin` |

releases.name: v1.2.6: save backups, movies keep their shape, every controller works
releases.body:
**Save backups, movies that keep their shape, and two controllers at once.**

- **Save backups** (*CTRL → Game → Save backups …*): copies of all your save slots in a folder you choose, outside the app, so uninstalling the game doesn't delete them. A copy is made after the game saves, at most every 10 minutes. The latest 10 and one for each of the last 7 days played are kept, up to 64 MB in all (the latest 3 always). A backup can be restored from the same screen; it takes effect at the next start, and the saves it replaces are kept aside.
- **Movies are never stretched.** They keep their 16:9 shape with **Wide screen** on, and now also with **Stretch to fill wide screens** on. A movie whose own picture has black bars at the top and bottom as well (bars on all four sides) is zoomed in, centred, until one pair of bars is gone, without cutting anything off.
- **Controllers:** every connected controller now controls the game. Before, with two connected (for example a handheld's built-in controls and an external pad), the second one's buttons were ignored.

releases.name: v1.2.5: render resolution and true wide screens
releases.body:
**Choose the render resolution, and true wide screens.**

- **Resolution** (*CTRL → Image*, applies at the next start): **540p**, **720p** (as on the Xbox 360, the default) or **1080p**. The 3D world is drawn at that size; menus and the HUD stay sharp at 720p. 540p is faster and a little softer. 1080p is scaled down into the 720p picture, which smooths edges rather than adding detail, and needs a fast GPU.
- **Wide screen** (*CTRL → Image*, applies at the next start): on screens wider than 16:9 (most phones), the 3D world fills the whole screen, with more to see at the sides instead of black bars or stretching. Menus, the HUD and the minimap stay in the middle, laid out as on a 16:9 screen, and movies keep 16:9 with black bars. It costs some speed: on a Galaxy S10 (Adreno 640) the field runs at about 24.5 fps instead of 28. Off by default.
- With both left at their defaults, the picture is the same as in v1.2.4.

releases.name: v1.2.4: tidier CTRL menu with Exit game, fixes for more phones
releases.body:
**A tidier CTRL menu with Exit game, and fixes for more phones from the Dark Souls II port.**

- **CTRL menu:** the options are now in sections that open one at a time: *Controls*, *Frame rate and performance*, *Image*, *Second screen*, *Game* and *Troubleshooting*. **Exit game** (top right) closes the game after asking; save in the game's main menu first. After changing an option marked *, the menu offers to restart the game so it takes effect.
- **CTRL button:** under *Controls* it can stay on screen, slide into a small tab when not in use, or go away 30 seconds after the game starts. Once it's gone, Android's Back button or gesture opens the menu.
- **Frame rate:** one list with 30, 40, 60 and *60 fps, smoother* (the former 120 Hz option).
- **Mali GPUs (Dimensity, Exynos, Tensor):** the app now starts on Arm's own driver, with the renderer settings that fixed Mali players' glitches in the Dark Souls II port, which shares this renderer. Still untested on a real Mali phone: reports with logs are welcome.
- **Adreno 8xx (Snapdragon 8 Elite):** Turnip now runs in sysmem mode there, which fixed GPU hangs on these chips in the Dark Souls II port.

releases.name: v1.2.3: fix for Adreno 600-series GPUs
releases.body:
**Fix for Adreno 600-series GPUs (Snapdragon 855 / 865 / 870 / 888 and similar).**

- **Adreno 6xx:** the renderer no longer loses work on these GPUs. Missing menu text, garbled or black pictures and wrong colours came from the Turnip driver on Adreno 6xx dropping some of the renderer's compute work (texture loads and render-to-texture copies) when it was set up while a drawing pass was still open. The fix closes the pass first. It was found by the Dark Souls II port's frame capture on an Adreno 640 and tested here on a Galaxy S10 (Adreno 640) (#4). Adreno 7xx/8xx draw the same as before, at the same speed.

**Updating from v1.2.2:** install `lr-recomp-android-arm64.apk` (below) over it. Your saves, game files, shaders and settings are kept.

releases.name: v1.2.2: infinite HP, stretch to fill wide screens
releases.body:
**Infinite HP, and a stretch option for wide phone screens.**

- **Infinite HP (in battle):** a new cheat under **CTRL → Cheats**. Lightning's HP goes back to its maximum after every hit. A single hit larger than her maximum HP can still knock her out (#5).
- **Infinite EP** checked in battle, including the first tutorial battle: Overclock and the other EP abilities are refilled at once (#5).
- **Stretch to fill wide screens:** a new option under **CTRL → Image**. On phones wider than 16:9 it removes the black bars at the sides by stretching the picture sideways. It applies the next time the game starts (#6).
- **Regression tests:** a battle test for both cheats on the Thor.

**Updating from v1.2.1:** install `lr-recomp-android-arm64.apk` (below) over it. Your saves, game files, shaders and settings are kept.

releases.body:
### Faster

- **Up to 7% more frames a second, with nothing to set.** The renderer copies less between its
  render targets: when a draw is about to cover an area completely, the old picture there is no
  longer copied in first. The picture is unchanged.
  - At the King's Camp, the game went from 42.0 to 44.8 frames a second.
  - With FSR 3.1 Balanced, it went from 34.0 to 35.3.

### New: Eco shading

**Options -> Visual -> Eco shading** trades a little sharpness in the 3D scene for speed: the
scene's colours are worked out once for each two pixels (**Light**) or each block of four
(**Strong**). It is off by default and takes effect from the next start.
- **The HUD, text and the edges of leaves and grass stay sharp.** So do shadows and the
  post-processing.

releases.name: WoW Mobile v0.1.2
releases.body:
Fixes the ConsolePort wizard reappearing on every login ([reported on Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/EmulationOnAndroid/)).

If you interacted with the addon's controller-setup wizard during your very first login, WoW saved a half-finished configuration that blocked the automatic setup from ever applying — so the wizard kept coming back. The app now re-checks your account every time you press PLAY and repairs that state automatically (your previous file is kept as `ConsolePort.lua.bak`).

**If you were affected:** update, exit the game completely, press PLAY again. The wizard should be gone and the full pad mapped.

Also clarifies the first-login instructions shown in the app. Non-English clients (frFR, deDE, …) are fully supported — the locale was unrelated to this bug.

A stability and hygiene patch for v2.0.0, focused on the crash and antivirus reports from the first few hours.

## Downloads

- Windows: `Skate3Recomp-Windows.zip`
- Linux: `Skate3Recomp-Linux.zip`
- macOS: `Skate3Recomp-macOS.zip`

## Changes

#### Stability

- Fixed a crash on Linux and macOS where the game could die suddenly during gameplay when world streaming revoked memory the renderer was reading
- Fixed distant demoted tree trunks rendering with a flat blue texture

#### Antivirus false positives

- The Windows executable and runtime DLL now carry proper version metadata, and the runtime no longer contains any ability to create executable memory (it never used it - all game code is compiled at build time); both changes target the machine-learning heuristics some antivirus engines were tripping on
- A false-positive report has been filed with Microsoft for the v2.0.0 files; if your antivirus quarantined the runtime, restore it or re-download this release

#### Diagnostics

- The game now logs its exact build version at startup, so support logs identify the build they came from

The entire game renders natively at close visual parity with the console output, with a set of optional modern graphics enhancements that seek to go beyond it.

The new native renderer is early and is likely to have issues, I haven't tested the game all the way through.

releases.body:
What's new in 0.78

For players
- **32-bit devices:** one APK now holds both ARMv8 (arm64-v8a) and ARMv7
  (armeabi-v7a). Android picks the right one on install, so 64-bit devices
  always run the 64-bit version. OpenGL ES 3.0 is still required.
- **Screen orientation:** the setting now applies to the launcher as well as
  the game and takes effect at once. Auto respects the system rotation lock.
- **Sound:** the audio buffer margin now adapts to the device.
- **Launcher:** new Advanced screen with a Debug mode switch. With it off,
  nothing is written to the log.
- **Logs:** new screen under Data to export, share or send logs to the
  developer, or clear them.

Under the hood
- **Most of the game is now ported C++:** - game code is moving from recompiled to ported native ARM code.
- **Old processor code removed:** x87 emulation is gone from the generated
  code, and the whole game runs in 24-bit floating point. MMX, CPU detection
  and the Pentium FDIV workarounds are removed too.

Known limits
- ARMv7 has only been tested in the 32-bit mode of a 64-bit phone, not on a
  real 32-bit device, so speed on older hardware is unknown.

releases.name: v0.77
releases.body:
What's new:

### For players
- **Dynamic Fullscreen for races.** A new Screen Size option that fits the race to your phone's shape (20:9, 16:9, tablets) with no black bars, you can find it in Resolution tabs in-game Graphics settings. The view widens to the sides and the HUD keeps its proportions. It is the default for new imports. 
- **Options on the first screen.** The "NFS Web Site" button is now "Options...", so the settings are one tap away.
- **Gamepads: Analog or Digital** (Controls → Gamepads). In Digital mode you steer with the D-pad and use the triggers for gas and brake, like a keyboard.
- **Force feedback: one choice, Off / Phone / Gamepad**, instead of two separate switches. The in-game Stick Volume slider now actually sets the vibration strength (it used to always be full).
- **Dead zone and saturation** from the game's own Dead Zone screen now work, separately for the stick and each trigger.
- **The demo movie no longer freezes** on its last frame.
- **Split screen** uses the Modern Patch layout.

### Under the hood (same behaviour, now native code instead of recompiled)

releases.name: v0.76
releases.body:
What's new:

- New launcher UI on Compose.
- Network races work: phone with phone over Wi-Fi (IPX or TCP/IP), and phone with a PC running the Modern Patch over TCP/IP, as host or client.
- Disc image import: the launcher reads the game straight from an ISO or BIN/CUE image, on the first start and on the Data screen.
- Faster and cooler: the renderer driver and about fifty of the game's heaviest functions now run as native code. Each was checked bit for bit against the original. Removed voodoo2a emulation wrapper - now GPU code is fully native OpenGLES. 
- Rear-view mirror like the main view: full draw distance, track detail, full-size cars, sky with clouds and lightning, car lights and headlights.
- Fixed bugs on certain devices with saves.

Обновление **1.8.0** исправляет запуск бандлов `.bcxi` и стабильность рендерера на одноэкранных смартфонах, переносит весь блок **P0 + P1** улучшений из **Azahar 2127.0** и добавляет инструменты обслуживания игр в библиотеке ROM.

## Исправление запуска `.bcxi` и стабильности рендерера

- **Защита вторичной поверхности (`HasValidSecondarySurface`)**: в `RendererVulkan` и `RendererOpenGL` добавлена строгая проверка `secondary_window` и `render_surface != nullptr` перед созданием/переключением swapchain и ожиданием `WaitPresent()`. Устраняет падение `Presentation not supported on this platform` (`vk_platform.cpp:201`) на смартфонах без физического второго дисплея при запуске `.bcxi` и других игр.
- **Корректная работа `TarIOFile` и `AutoOpenNCCHNCSD`**: в `TarIOFile::OpenCopy()` сохраняется признак `IOType::Type::TarIOFile` (`IsFileBundle()`), а распаковка вложенных образов в `AutoOpenNCCHNCSD` выполнена итеративно, что обеспечивает стабильную загрузку `.bcxi`/`.bcci` и встроенных в них `.zcxi`/`.cxi`/`.zcia`.

releases.name: v0.4.10
releases.body:
Faster starts with mods installed, plus housekeeping for the releases themselves. Everything from [0.4.9](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.9) is included.

## Mods

- **Mods no longer slow down every start.** The port used to read every file of every mod in `mods` at each start to check it, which took seconds with big mods. It now remembers those checks and only reads a file again when its size or date changes. The first start after installing or updating a mod takes as long as before; the next ones skip that work.

## Android

- The APK's internal version number jumps from 39 to 4010. It still installs over the old one; nothing to do on your side.

## Install / update

Windows: download `gow2-recomp-0.4.10-win64.zip` and copy the **contents** of its `gow2-recomp-0.4.10-win64` folder into your game folder. Your `gow2.toml` and saves are kept.

releases.name: v0.4.9
releases.body:
Achievement names in Cyrillic, Korean and Chinese, a saving message that no longer mentions a console, better Mali detection on Android, Esc going back in menus, and the first community contributions, all from optimistic-blip. Everything from [0.4.8](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.8) is included.

## Fixes

- **Achievement names in every language (#54).** The achievement pop-up and the achievement list (F7) are drawn by the port with a small Latin-only font, so Russian, Polish, Czech, Hungarian, Korean and Chinese names showed up as `?????`. That font now gets Cyrillic and the Central European letters from a system font (Segoe UI on Windows, Roboto on Android), plus Korean or Traditional Chinese glyphs when the game runs in one of those languages.
- **"Please don't turn off your PC" (#64).** The checkpoint message said "console". It now says PC in all 12 languages, and "device" on Android. The text is changed at run time like the port's other text edits; the game folder is not touched. The idea, and a tool for changing the file itself, came from optimistic-blip.

releases.name: v0.4.8
releases.body:
Co-op settings no longer have to match between friends, players 3 and up get their own Centaur in the tank chapter, and the native renderer stops smearing textures on AMD cards. Everything from [0.4.7](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.7) is included.

## Co-op

- **The host's settings apply to everyone in that campaign.** Before, a friend whose co-op settings differed from the host's (player count, extra players ending the game, and so on) did not see the campaign at all. Now only the release has to match: friends see the host's campaign whatever their own `gow2_coop_players` and co-op options say, and the host's settings decide how that campaign plays. Campaigns from a different release still stay hidden, and since 0.4.8 that check covers two-player games too.
- **One Centaur per player in the tank chapter.** When Marcus drives the Centaur, every player 3 and up gets a tank of their own next to him instead of hanging off his. If someone leaves their tank, dies, or falls too far behind, they get a new one next to Marcus; the extra tanks go away when the tank section ends. `gow2_coop_tanks = false` turns it off.

releases.name: v0.4.7
releases.body:
Phones get new defaults that run smoother and cooler, voices on Android should come through again, and every platform gets a Render scale option. Everything from [0.4.6](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.6) is included.

## Android

- **Frame rate unlocked with a 45 fps limit, by default.** Uncapped, the phone's GPU runs at full load until the phone lowers its clock as it heats up; the limit keeps headroom. The limit drops to the nearest rate that divides your screen's refresh, so every frame lasts the same: 40 fps on a 120 Hz screen (Galaxy S24/S25), 45 at 90 Hz, 30 at 60 Hz. On an S25 Ultra frame times went from a 25/25/16.7 ms mix to an even 25 ms. You can still pick 30, 60 or no limit in Device Options > Display > Frame rate limit.
- **Render scale 75 % by default.** The 3D scene is drawn at 75 % and scaled up to the screen; on an S25 Ultra that is 14 % less GPU work per frame, with a slightly softer picture. Graphics > Render scale goes back to 100 %.
- **Snapdragon GSR for the final upscale by default**, one pass instead of FSR 1's two.

releases.name: v0.4.6
releases.body:
Insane can now be picked from the start. Everything from [0.4.5](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.5) is included; if you have not read its notes, they cover the Riftworm fix for Vulkan, GPU detection on Linux and Proton, and the co-op go-to-player-1 key.

## Every platform

- **Insane without finishing the campaign first.** The option from 0.4.5, now named **All chapters and Insane unlocked** (PC Options > Saves, on by default), also enables the Insane button in the difficulty menu, in solo Campaign and in the co-op lobby. Before, the game greyed it out until the campaign had been finished once. As with chapters, only the menu check changes: your saved progress and the Extras list of unlockables are not touched.

## Known, still open

- Lighting that looks pixelated on Linux with presets above Low, and black textures on Low on Windows (both on a Legion Go): we could not reproduce them on our PC. A screenshot and the `logs/gow2_*.log` of the run, with the chapter, help a lot.

releases.body:
Another week another release . There are ton of changes , so why not ? 

## Core
* Properly check where an input came from for digital->analog input smoothing

* file_sys: Report stable file identities in stat and fstat 
* Allow file type identification for '/addcont' path
* emulator: stop clearing temporary data on boot 
* Add PT_SCE_MODULE_PARAM case
* cpu_patches: Fix JIT patching at addresses outside any module
* core: Fix MemoryManager::Free unmapping past the released rang
* file_sys: don't abort when a guest path goes through a regular file
* use VMA pointers instead of copies in TryWriteBacking 
* cpu_patches: Workaround Rosetta 2 crash on VMASKMOVPS/PD
* Handle ELF metadata and toolchain comments program headers
* common: reuse one high-resolution waitable timer per thread in AccurateSleep

This release is following the first official stable release of shadNet 0.1.0, so we have some online playability available (yes Bloodborne fans, online Bloodborne is now officially available). There are also a tons of fixes to different areas of emu , you can check the list below. The release is dedicated to our friend Stephen, who is taking a break from shadPS4 due of his studies. Stephen if you are reading this we already miss you ;/

releases.name: shadps4 v0.19.0 - codename The Shadoween special

Welcome back to another shadPS4 release . It is over one month since our previous release and guess what we are back again with a lot more fixes and a lot more playable games . Rapid work has been done in different areas of the emu, but i guess the glory goes to the huge amount of GPU fixes that improved so many games, some of them are really playable now . releases.name: shadps4 v0.18.0 - codename UltraPersona
releases.body:
shadPS4 v0.18.0 "UltraPersona"

Hello there, it hasn't been a while, has it? While not much time has passed since our last stable release, we are here again with a brand new one. The main reason for this release is broken shadNet authorization in certain cases on the 0.17.0 release, but we have some more interesting new features as well.

Firstly, after some fixes, AvPlayer can now be loaded as LLE, meaning that you need the `libSceAvPlayer.sprx` (and `libSceAvPlayerStreaming.sprx`) module(s), which makes broken videos in a few games now work properly.

The above change was enabled by calling `sceLibcInternalMemoryMutexEnable` in LLE LibcInternal at boot, found by [@liuk7071](https://github.com/liuk7071), the developer of ChonkyStation4, another PS4 emulator.

A kernel event flag rewrite has also fixed Shadow of the Colossus often hanging on boot, and the game now consistently gets to menus.

releases.name: RunnerBuilder 0.3.3
releases.body:
Builds your own Android APK of the PC version from your own copy of Mirror's Edge from GOG. Other releases of the game do not work.

**New in 0.3.3: much faster.**
- Before the build the program asks where the result goes: a device over USB or Wi-Fi debugging, or a folder only. With a device, the game files are copied to it **while** the game's code is being built, and the finished app is installed at the end. No ZIP is made then.
- A first build takes about 5 minutes on a fast PC (was about 10): the translation runs in parallel and a 2-3 minute stall at the end of every build is gone.
- The build is kept: after an update of the program it takes a minute or two instead of starting over.
- The window is sharp on screens scaled to 125-200%.
- App 0.3.3: no more 1-second freezes when the game restarts its rendering thread (a sleep in the game's own code, skipped); PlayStation button icons when a DualSense is connected during play; a clear message while the game's code is still being built.

Tested on one PC and a Lenovo Y700: a full build with install over Wi-Fi in about 5 minutes. **Not tested yet:** the full 11.5 GB copy during a build, USB, the 1-second freeze fix in long play.

# NSP Box 4.0.0 — Meet NUP

Smaller archives, flexible packaging, and more control over your game collection. Version 4.0 introduces **NUP Tools**, alongside the existing NSP builder.

### Package more. Store less.

- **Create compressed NUP archives** from extracted game folders, with base games, updates and DLC together in one file.
- **Choose your balance:** Fast for quicker compression, Balanced for everyday use, or Smaller for stronger compression. Incompressible files are stored raw automatically.
- **Keep what you need:** select Base, Updates and DLC independently. Choices appear after inspection, only for content present in your source. Latest-snapshot mode merges the newest selected update with the selected base, retains required base-only files, and leaves superseded versions behind. Turn it off to keep separate base/update records.
- **Avoid duplicate storage:** identical file contents can share the same space inside an archive.
- **Stay compatible:** leave files larger than 256 MiB uncompressed to reduce temporary decompression work in supported emulators.

### Convert, extract and check

- **NSP → NUP:** compress plaintext NSPs created by NSP Box.

- `Makefile`: настройки сборки по умолчанию переведены на `-O2`; добавлена опциональная сборка с фиксированной базой гостевой памяти через `FIXED_ARENA`.
- `runtime/rt.c`, `runtime/rt.h`: поддержка фиксированной базы памяти; для x86 оптимизированы чтение/запись гостевой памяти и барьеры.
- `tools/recomp.py`: изменения генератора кода, включая подсказки компилятору для указателей; после таких изменений требуется регенерировать `out/`.

- `runtime/hle_d3d9_gl.h`: кэш состояния `glVertexAttribPointer`, чтобы пропускать повторную настройку атрибутов без изменений.
- `runtime/hle_d3d9_vk.h`: выбор режима презентации Vulkan через `ME1_VSYNC=0`, если режим поддерживается драйвером; обычный режим по умолчанию сохраняется.
- `runtime/hle.h`, `runtime/hle_sys.c`, `runtime/hle_win32.c`: подсчёт статистики HLE сделан опциональным (`ME1_HLE_STATS`/`ME1_HB`), чтобы не выполнять атомарное увеличение счётчика при каждом вызове.

# v1.2.1 — GEARMASS: нагрузка на все ядра; буфер команд («планировщик») из «me_1.2», доработанный

## GEARMASS — распределение нагрузки (`runtime/gearmass.c`)
Новая подсистема порта: решает, сколько потоков работает, как главные потоки ждут друг друга, на каких ядрах
они живут, сколько кадров CPU готовит вперёд и как поднимать качество, пока GPU свободен. **Никаких списков
телефонов и компьютеров**: всё выводится из топологии (число ядер, их частоты из `cpufreq`) и из замеров во время
игры.

Режимы (`ME1_GEARMASS`, лаунчеры → «Нагрузка (GEARMASS)» → «Режим нагрузки», `me1port.ini` `[Port] Gearmass`):

| | Эконом `eco` | Баланс `balance` | Производительность `perf` | Максимум `max` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Поток рендера `me1-d3d` (`ME1_D3D_CMD`) | 0 | 2 * | 2 * | 2 * |
| Рабочие потоки (`ME1_GM_WORKERS`) | 0 | до 2 | все свободные | все свободные |
| Кадров вперёд (`ME1_GM_AHEAD`) | 0 | 1 | 1 | 2 |
| Ожидание главных потоков (`ME1_GM_SPIN`) | сон | короткий спин | короткий спин | спин |
| Главные потоки на быстрых ядрах (`ME1_GM_PRIME`) | нет | нет | да | да |

releases.name: v1.0.0 — Winlator 适配包
releases.body:
在 Android（[Winlator](https://github.com/brunodev85/winlator)）与 ARM Linux（Wine + Box64）上运行 DFLegacy 60 版单机端的适配包。

## 包含

| 文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `d3d8.dll` | d3d8to9 v1.15.1 预编译包装层（x86，124 KB） |
| `LICENSE.md` | d3d8to9 的 BSD-3-Clause 许可 |
| `使用说明.md` | 完整部署说明 |
| `放置说明.txt` | 快速上手 |

## 解决什么问题

客户端是 2008 年的 32 位程序，**只认 Direct3D 8**。Android 上的 DXVK 只支持 D3D9 及以上，直接跑会黑屏或崩溃。

这个 `d3d8.dll` 把 D3D8 调用逐条翻译成 D3D9：

```
DNF.exe → d3d8.dll → D3D9 → DXVK → Vulkan → Adreno / Mali
```

绕开 Wine 自带的 `wined3d → OpenGL` 路径，走 Vulkan 后端。

## 用法

1. 解压，把 `d3d8.dll` 复制到 `DNF.exe` 同级目录
2. Winlator 容器里设 `WINEDLLOVERRIDES=d3d8=n,b`
3. Box86 / Box64 都打开，DXVK 选 2.x
4. 运行 `DNF.exe`

**Windows 本机不要放这个文件** —— 原生 D3D8 路径工作正常，放进去反而改变渲染路径。

## 前提

服务端需要是 x86 构建（NativeAOT `-r win-x86`），否则在纯 32 位环境里加载不了。相关改动见 [DFLegacyAot](https://github.com/Yoshino-Loli/DFLegacyAot)。

## 未验证项

- `ijl15.dll` 的 WIC JPEG 解码在 Wine 下的表现
- Job Object 的退出联动在 Wine 下的可靠性（失败时手动结束服务端即可）

真机帧数需自行测试，骁龙 8 系预期 25~40 fps。

## 不包含

游戏客户端本体与任何受版权保护的资源。`DNF.exe`、`Script.pvf`、`ImagePacks2` 等权利归原权利人所有。

## ZeraPS5 0.1.1 build 1214

This Windows x64 release updates the Vulkan shader compiler and includes the launcher and GPU writeback fixes shipped in b1192.

The translator simplifies a waterfall loop when it can prove that the emulated lane runs the body once. The new regression check covers both that case and a saved-mask register overlap where the loop must be retained.

Development testing of Grand Theft Auto VI reached the loading screen. The observation covers startup through loading. The translator change can trigger pipeline recreation on the first run.

### Validation

- 196 automated checks passed in the final serial runs, including 35 Vulkan checks on an RTX 5060 Ti.
- The b1192 updater installed the final ZIP in an isolated copy, preserved all five test data markers and passed rollback and interrupted-installation recovery.

## ZeraPS5 v0.1.1 build 1191

The Windows x64 package includes matching sources, component licenses and relinkable objects. Some titles require the user’s own `libSceAgc.sprx`. The package excludes firmware modules and shaders extracted from them.

### Technical changes

- **Vulkan presentation.** Find GPU-written framebuffers through another mapping of the same memory. This fixed black output in the recorded development runs of The Messenger and Goodnight Universe.
- **Compute and writeback.** Start another batch when the writeback list fills. Finish queued reads while guest mappings remain pinned and compare GPU results with the same snapshot that was uploaded. Require 32-lane compute subgroups when the shader uses cross-lane operations.
- **System services.** Extend AMM and AMPR memory and file operations, add semaphore and Audio3D handling, and provide non-PSSR fallback responses from `libScePsml`.
- **Launcher.** Show the library counts when no system library is installed. Keep the missing-module message for games that require one. Supported Unreal profiles can also be read from PKG and exFAT applications.
